description: Realized-state contextualizer for Oracle truth synthesis.
purpose: This contract defines `realized_hindsight_brief`, the interpretive Oracle artifact emitted by `oracle_truth_map`. It summarizes what actually happened at T, classifies the major realized drivers, and contextualizes prediction-target outcomes before critique or hindsight CP2 reconstruction begins.

regime_summary.constraint: Readable summary of the realized system regime.

driver_classification.constraint: Non-empty. Each major realized package must appear exactly once.

prediction_target_outcomes.constraint: Must cover every target present in prediction_reconciliation.rows.

rules: Every major realized package must be classified exactly once.
already_observed_packages, surprise_packages, and partial_change_packages must be mutually exclusive.
Mixed cases belong in PARTIAL_CHANGE, not dual classification.

boundary.description: This artifact may use truth-side context freely, but it does not create final admissible grounding claims and it does not perform critique.

validator: Contract-only in Batch A. Runtime prompt/output alignment lands in Batch B Oracle node upgrades.

unresolved_contract.semantics: Observed movement with unestablished causal or availability interpretation; no surprise, change or foresight implied. Keep package lists mutually exclusive.
